targets.rawSql: WITH categorized AS ( SELECT r.domain, COALESCE(kr3.category_id, kr2.category_id) AS target_category_id, CASE WHEN kr3.category_id IS NOT NULL THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS category_depth FROM sync.keepa_asin_registry r JOIN sync.keepa_category_registry kr2 ON kr2.domain = r.domain AND kr2.parent_id = r.root_category_id AND kr2.depth = 2 AND kr2.category_en = NULLIF(split_part(r.category_path, ' > ', 2), '') LEFT JOIN sync.keepa_category_registry kr3 ON kr3.domain = r.domain AND kr3.parent_id = kr2.category_id AND kr3.depth = 3 AND kr3.category_en = NULLIF(split_part(r.category_path, ' > ', 3), '') WHERE r.is_active AND r.root_category_id IS NOT NULL AND r.category_path IS NOT NULL AND r.category_path <> '' AND r.domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote}) ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ( SELECT target_category_id, domain FROM categorized WHERE target_category_id IS NOT NULL AND category_depth IN (2,3) GROUP BY target_category_id, domain HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) filtered LEFT JOIN sync.discovery_expansion_state s ON s.expansion_type = 'category' AND s.domain = filtered.domain AND s.target_key = CAST(filtered.target_category_id AS VARCHAR) AND s.last_run_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '720 hours' WHERE s.target_key IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM sync.keyword_expansion_candidates WHERE is_candidate AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote})

panels.title: 近 7 天 shortlist 执行次数

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS runs FROM sync.collection_log WHERE source = 'strategy_category_expand' AND finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote})

panels.title: 近 7 天 keyword 执行次数

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS runs FROM sync.collection_log WHERE source = 'strategy_keyword_expand' AND finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote})

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(asins_succeeded), 0) AS new_asins FROM sync.collection_log WHERE source IN ('strategy_category_expand', 'strategy_keyword_expand') AND finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote})

panels.title: 近 7 天 token 跳过次数

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS skip_runs FROM sync.collection_log WHERE source IN ('strategy_category_skip', 'strategy_keyword_skip') AND error_message = 'token_insufficient' AND finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote})

WITH categorized AS ( SELECT r.domain, CASE r.domain WHEN 1 THEN 'US' WHEN 2 THEN 'GB' WHEN 3 THEN 'DE' WHEN 4 THEN 'FR' WHEN 5 THEN 'JP' WHEN 6 THEN 'CA' WHEN 8 THEN 'IT' WHEN 9 THEN 'ES' WHEN 10 THEN 'IN' WHEN 11 THEN 'MX' WHEN 12 THEN 'BR' WHEN 13 THEN 'AU' ELSE r.domain::text END AS domain_label, COALESCE(kr3.category_id, kr2.category_id) AS target_category_id, COALESCE(COALESCE(kr3.category_cn, kr3.category_en), COALESCE(kr2.category_cn, kr2.category_en)) AS target_category_name, CASE WHEN kr3.category_id IS NOT NULL THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS category_depth, COALESCE(kr3.product_count, kr2.product_count, 0) AS category_product_count FROM sync.keepa_asin_registry r JOIN sync.keepa_category_registry kr2 ON kr2.domain = r.domain AND kr2.parent_id = r.root_category_id AND kr2.depth = 2 AND kr2.category_en = NULLIF(split_part(r.category_path, ' > ', 2), '') LEFT JOIN sync.keepa_category_registry kr3 ON kr3.domain = r.domain AND kr3.parent_id = kr2.category_id AND kr3.depth = 3 AND kr3.category_en = NULLIF(split_part(r.category_path, ' > ', 3), '') WHERE r.is_active AND r.root_category_id IS NOT NULL AND r.category_path IS NOT NULL AND r.category_path <> '' AND r.domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote}) ) SELECT domain_label AS "站点", target_category_id AS "类目ID", LEFT(COALESCE(target_category_name, ''), 64) AS "类目", category_depth AS "层级", COUNT(*) AS "样本数", MAX(category_product_count) AS "类目商品数" FROM categorized WHERE target_category_id IS NOT NULL AND category_depth IN (2,3) GROUP BY domain_label, domain, target_category_id, target_category_name, category_depth HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT domain_label AS "站点", keyword AS "Keyword", mapped_asin_count AS "映射ASIN", mapped_p0_asin_count AS "映射P0", ROUND(trend_30d_avg::numeric, 1) AS "Trend30d", ROUND(trend_growth_7d::numeric, 2) AS "Trend增长", hot_days_over_30d_avg AS "Hot天数", expand_priority AS "Priority", hours_since_last_run AS "距上次运行h" FROM sync.keyword_expansion_candidates WHERE is_candidate AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote}) ORDER BY expand_priority DESC, trend_growth_7d DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30

panels.title: 执行与新增 ASIN 趋势

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', finished_at) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'strategy_category_expand' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shortlist_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'strategy_keyword_expand' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keyword_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN source IN ('strategy_category_expand', 'strategy_keyword_expand') THEN asins_succeeded ELSE 0 END) AS new_asins FROM sync.collection_log WHERE finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND source IN ('strategy_category_expand', 'strategy_keyword_expand') AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', finished_at) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'strategy_category_skip' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shortlist_skip_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'strategy_keyword_skip' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keyword_skip_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN source IN ('strategy_category_skip', 'strategy_keyword_skip') THEN asins_requested ELSE 0 END) AS skipped_candidates FROM sync.collection_log WHERE finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND source IN ('strategy_category_skip', 'strategy_keyword_skip') AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: token skip 后恢复执行趋势

targets.rawSql: WITH event_stream AS ( SELECT finished_at, domain, CASE WHEN source IN ('strategy_category_skip', 'strategy_category_expand') THEN 'shortlist' WHEN source IN ('strategy_keyword_skip', 'strategy_keyword_expand') THEN 'keyword' ELSE 'other' END AS expansion_type, CASE WHEN source IN ('strategy_category_skip', 'strategy_keyword_skip') THEN 'skip' ELSE 'expand' END AS event_kind, asins_succeeded FROM sync.collection_log WHERE finished_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND source IN ('strategy_category_skip', 'strategy_category_expand', 'strategy_keyword_skip', 'strategy_keyword_expand') AND domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote}) ), ordered AS ( SELECT finished_at, domain, expansion_type, event_kind, asins_succeeded, LAG(event_kind) OVER (PARTITION BY domain, expansion_type ORDER BY finished_at) AS prev_event_kind FROM event_stream ), bucketed AS ( SELECT date_trunc('hour', finished_at) + floor(date_part('minute', finished_at) / 5) * INTERVAL '5 minutes' AS time, expansion_type, event_kind, prev_event_kind, asins_succeeded FROM ordered ) SELECT time, SUM(CASE WHEN expansion_type = 'shortlist' AND event_kind = 'expand' AND prev_event_kind = 'skip' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shortlist_resume_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN expansion_type = 'keyword' AND event_kind = 'expand' AND prev_event_kind = 'skip' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keyword_resume_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN event_kind = 'expand' AND prev_event_kind = 'skip' THEN asins_succeeded ELSE 0 END) AS resumed_new_asins FROM bucketed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE expansion_type WHEN 'category' THEN 'shortlist' WHEN 'keyword' THEN 'keyword' ELSE expansion_type END AS "类型", CASE domain WHEN 1 THEN 'US' WHEN 2 THEN 'GB' WHEN 3 THEN 'DE' WHEN 4 THEN 'FR' WHEN 5 THEN 'JP' WHEN 6 THEN 'CA' WHEN 8 THEN 'IT' WHEN 9 THEN 'ES' WHEN 10 THEN 'IN' WHEN 11 THEN 'MX' WHEN 12 THEN 'BR' WHEN 13 THEN 'AU' ELSE domain::text END AS "站点", target_key AS "目标Key", LEFT(COALESCE(target_label, ''), 72) AS "标签", ROUND(last_priority_score::numeric, 2) AS "最近分数", last_candidate_count AS "最近候选数", last_new_asin_count AS "最近新增ASIN", total_new_asin_count AS "累计新增ASIN", run_count AS "执行次数", last_run_at AS "最近执行" FROM sync.discovery_expansion_state WHERE domain::text IN (${domain:singlequote}) ORDER BY run_count DESC, total_new_asin_count DESC, last_run_at DESC LIMIT 50

list.name: domain
list.label: 站点 (Domain)
list.query: SELECT domain::text AS __value, domain || '/' || CASE domain WHEN 1 THEN 'US' WHEN 2 THEN 'GB' WHEN 3 THEN 'DE' WHEN 4 THEN 'FR' WHEN 5 THEN 'JP' WHEN 6 THEN 'CA' WHEN 8 THEN 'IT' WHEN 9 THEN 'ES' WHEN 10 THEN 'IN' WHEN 11 THEN 'MX' WHEN 12 THEN 'BR' WHEN 13 THEN 'AU' END AS __text FROM sync.keepa_asin_registry GROUP BY domain ORDER BY domain
